title: Concept: Package source on the legacy V2 protocol
description: nuget.config declares a source pinned to protocol version 2, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: Without a recorded digest the downloaded artifact cannot be checked against what was reviewed, so substitution is undetectable at install time. This rule reads a source pinned to protocol version 2.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through nuget.config (nuget).
risk: Without a recorded digest the downloaded artifact cannot be checked against what was reviewed, so substitution is undetectable at install time. This rule reads a source pinned to protocol version 2.
